sym_op_t
typedef struct
sym_op_t

defines one symmetry operation

Members
type

single character: possible choices are 'R'(rotation), 'S'(spin rotation), 'M'(mirror), 'I'(inversion), 'F'(spin flip), 'E'(identity)

normal_vector

double[3]: the normal vector around which to generate the symmetry, in real space (irrelevant for 'I', 'F', 'E')

angle

double: angle of rotation (relevant for 'R', 'S')
